actions.reason: K4_C0001 has a coherent, strongly down-regulated transcriptomic identity (oxidative phosphorylation, complement, allograft-rejection, interferon programs; FDR q=0.001), providing substantive biological support. Membership representation is conflicting-to-weak (WXS modest, RNA/WSI marginal, CT absent), and the pair boundaries with K4_C0004 and K4_C0002 are conflicting-to-weak, but the structural pair diagnostics show the current boundary is represented (ARI 1.0 with K4_C0004; ARI 0.781 with K4_C0002) with within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity, and no split or merge is supported. The candidate remains a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K4_C0002 has a coherent up-regulated metabolic/mitochondrial transcriptomic identity (oxidative phosphorylation NES 2.79, protein secretion, fatty-acid metabolism, mTORC1; FDR q=0.001) and a coherent mutational identity (robust VHL and PBRM1 depletion), giving substantive biological support from two complementary sources. Membership representation is coherently negative across all four native geometries, which is a real weakness, but the pair boundaries with K4_C0003 and K4_C0001 show the current boundary is substantially represented (ARI 0.846 and 0.781) with within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity, and no split or merge is supported. The candidate retains defensible discovery value.

K4_C0003 has a coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic identity (allograft rejection NES 2.82, interferon-gamma/alpha responses, IL6/JAK/STAT3; FDR q=0.001), providing substantive biological support. Membership representation is conflicting (RNA and CT positive, WSI and WXS negative), and pair boundaries with K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 are weak-to-modest, but the structural pair diagnostics show the current boundary is substantially to strongly represented (ARI 0.846 and 0.879) with within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity, and no split or merge is supported. The candidate remains a defensible discovery-stage unit.

K4_C0004 has a coherent matrix/proliferative transcriptomic identity (UV-response-DN, Hedgehog, mitotic spindle, EMT, TGF-beta; oxidative phosphorylation down) and a coherent mutational identity (strong VHL enrichment, PBRM1 depletion), giving substantive biological support from two complementary sources. Membership representation is strongly conflicting (WXS strong, CT weak, RNA/WSI negative), and the pair boundary with K4_C0001 is conflicting-to-weak, but the structural pair diagnostics show the current boundary is strongly represented (ARI 0.879 with K4_C0003; ARI 1.0 with K4_C0001) with within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity, and no split or merge is supported. The candidate retains defensible discovery value.
